subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 9: /e/ (set, net, pet, ten, pen); differentiates k and e; identifies initial sounds

show.line: Listen. e, e, egg. e, e, net! Net has the e sound.

rounds.prompt: Which word has the e sound? Pen, pan.
Say the sound with me. e, as in egg!
Listen. t, e, n. What word is it?
Listen. p, e, t. What word is it?
Is it k or e? Listen. Egg.

hints: Open your mouth a little. e, e, egg.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Listen. n, e, t.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! n, e, t makes net.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's do it together. n, e, t. Net!

parent_line: Can hear the e sound and blend words like ten, pet and net.
